station_name: BIG CHICO CREEK NEAR CHICO, CALIF.
notes: Digitized table covers the daily grid and the peak-discharge block below it. Daily values counted by month: 31+30+31+31+28+31+30+31+30+31+31+30 = 365. Peak block: 3 peaks, each with gage height and discharge = 6 (time not counted). Summary values: 5 foot rows x 12 months = 60, plus 5 values in each of the calendar-year and water-year rows = 10. Other distances on page: 7 miles northeast of Chico; 1.8 miles upstream from golf clubhouse in Bidwell Park; 2.6 miles upstream from Lindo Channel. Resolution given as daily (main grid); the peak block alone would be annual.
